reply:
Good — that's a real move. Notes app tonight, no sending, no opening the file. The draft just sits there and stops living in your head.

And "see about sending it" is fine. You don't have to decide tonight whether you're the kind of person who sends it at 9 a.m. You just have to have it ready so the option's there when you're awake and it's a normal hour.

One thing worth doing while you're in the notes app: put the reminder on the same note. Not "send this" — something like "read this at 9 and decide." Takes the pressure off the decision and puts it where you can actually make it.

The sixty's still the sixty, and two weeks is still two weeks. But tonight you're not solving it — you're just making sure tomorrow has a move in it.
